source.quote_free_summary: Whenever possible, for multiple heats of varied sizes the smaller heat 'shall precede' the greater, to help scratches be re-balanced.

requirement: A UCWDC profile should place smaller heats first where possible.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Advisory/conditional language: tracked as a compliance gap, NOT a mandatory hard blocker, and must not be enforced as one. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: 'shall' is qualified by 'Whenever possible', so it is treated as conditional/advisory, not an unconditional hard blocker; confirm with the owner whether any form is mandatory before activation.
